weight_management_program.text:
PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 01/12/2026
S: 34 y/o M wants to lose weight — New Year's resolution, and BP has been higher. Eats fast food at work, snacks at night. Gym membership but hasn't gone regularly.
O: Wt 98.6 kg, Ht 163 cm, BMI 37.1. BP 141/85.
Exam: CV RRR, no edema.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 37.1 — plan starting today:
 - Reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1400 kcal/day with food logging in a phone app.
 - Gym sessions (treadmill + light weights) 4 days a week, ~150 min/week.
 - Enrolled in the clinic's Healthy Weight lifestyle program; RD visit scheduled.
 Follow-up visits planned.
2. Hypertension: BP 141/85 on amlodipine 5 mg daily; continue; home log.
3. Anxiety — stable.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 01/26/2026
Healthy Weight program intake. Food log: drive-through lunch, energy drinks, late-night chips.
Plan: ~1400 kcal/day logged in phone app; pack lunch; no energy drinks; pre-portioned evening snack.
Activity: gym 4 days/week, treadmill + weights, ~150 min/week.
RD follow-up in 4 weeks.

TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER — 02/27/2026
RN call re: missed dietitian follow-up. Patient states he stopped following the meal plan and stopped going to the gym a few weeks ago — work has been very stressful (new manager, overtime). He cancelled the dietitian follow-up and does not wish to reschedule at this time. Encouraged to call when ready.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/08/2026
S: 35 y/o M here about weight and BP. Tried diet and exercise earlier this year without much success. Work stress improving. Asks about Wegovy. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 95.9 kg, BMI 36.1. BP 131/84.
